subject: Weekly leadership check-in: wins, risks, asks + QBR prep
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly leadership check-in: wins, risks, asks + QBR prep

Team — quick weekly pulse ahead of next week's QBR. TL;DR: solid traction on two anchor customers, one growing risk in infra latency that could affect demos, and three small asks to surface to execs for decision. Attaching a short deck (QBR-deck-v2) and appendix for metrics.

Wins:
- ACME POC finished e2e smoke tests; Lina confirmed integration stably handles 10k concurrent sessions in our staging region. Happy path validated.
- Dedicated capacity beta: onboarding script reduced start-up time from 18m -> 6m (Marissa + infra team). Means better demo reliability and lower cost for warm pools.
- Model serving P99 latency improved ~12% after kernel selection changes; rolling to 2 more pools next week.

Risks / concerns:
- Region-us-west-2: intermittent KV cache eviction spikes observed (~3–4x above baseline) during afternoon production traffic on 3/18. Root cause suspected to be a workload skew from a single tenant. If not mitigated, this will increase demo flakiness and could push SLA exceptions.
- QBR deck still missing the competitive benchmarking slide with cost-per-token comparisons (we need data by Monday).

Asks (decision / action items):
1) Exec sign-off on a short-term throttling policy to isolate the noisy tenant in us-west-2 (recommended: soft cap + alerting, then scheduled eviction window). Owner: Karthik. Target: decision by Mon 3/22.
2) Approve a one-time credit for ACME to cover their onboarding costs (ask: $30k). Owner: Laura to confirm legal/billing implications.
3) Resource permission to bump Dedicated beta to +2 pools for the weekend prep runs (one-time cloud spend approval). Owner: Marissa.

Notes for QBR prep:
- Please review appendix tab "Latency by model" in qbr-readout-appendix.xlsx and add one slide of interpretation on the competitive slide.
- Lina from ACME will join the customer spot in the QBR flyby — they asked for a 5-min segment on the integration story.

Attachments: QBR-deck-v2.pptx (master), qbr-readout-appendix.xlsx (metrics).

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
VP, Platform & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership check-in: wins, risks, asks + QBR prep

Thanks Sean — nice concise note. A couple quick items:

- On the ACME credit: finance is okay with a customer onboarding credit provided Sales documents an expansion plan and we capture a PO. I'll follow up with Lina and request the PO before we finalize.
- Throttling policy: agree we should isolate the noisy tenant. Can we get the estimated customer impact matrix (who will be affected, rollover windows) before signing off? Karthik, can you add that to the confluence note?
- Competitive slide: I'll draft one slide with cost-per-token comparatives using the appendix numbers; posting to the Drive by EOD Monday.

Also, small ask — can Marissa confirm whether the +2 pools can be provisioned without a multiday lead time? If provisioning is >24h we'll need to do a controlled demo schedule.

Laura Bennett
COO (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership check-in: wins, risks, asks + QBR prep

Ack — we can stand up +2 pools for the weekend prep; ephemeral cost estimate ~ $4.5k for 48 hours. No long lead-time, but we need final approval by 09:00 PT Monday to schedule capacity and smoke runs. I've attached a short cost breakdown and included the runbook link in the drive.

Attachment stub: dedicated-beta-costs-48h.pdf (pdf)

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success & SRE
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership check-in: wins, risks, asks + QBR prep

Perfect — quick decisions and next steps below so we have a crisp QBR runbook: 

Decisions: 
- Throttling policy: provisional yes. Karthik, please post the impact matrix + precise throttle thresholds to the Confluence page by Mon 03/22 10:00 PT; I'll sign off after a quick review.
- ACME credit: Laura to confirm receipt of PO; if PO present, finance approves the $30k onboarding credit.
- Dedicated pools: approved for weekend prep (Marissa cost estimate accepted). Finance to record as one-off.

Action owners & deadlines:
- Karthik Iyer: impact matrix + throttle thresholds -> Confluence -> Mon 03/22 10:00 PT.
- Marissa Cole: provision +2 pools and run smoke tests -> complete by Tue 03/23 09:00 PT. Post run results in Drive.
- Laura Bennett: get PO from ACME and confirm billing route -> Mon 03/22 EOD.
- Sean: finalize QBR deck slides for exec summary and customer spot -> Mon 03/22 18:00 PT.

I'll consolidate the final action slide and push a labeled copy to the Drive (link below) and notify the exec distro. If anyone needs changes to the deck, flag them in the shared comment thread.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QbrExampleLink
HubSpot: 17654 (ACME Expansion)

Thanks all — on it.

Sean Gallagher
VP, Platform & Ops
Redwood Inference
